$comment: Source of truth for AutoFactory Phase 1 routing tags (issue #9 item #5). Each agent emits tags via tag_conversation (or a write tool sets them); the graph edges and the approval gate route on them. This registry is validated by `npm run check:configs` against the graph (config/agentcontrol/graphs/), the agent instructions (config/agentcontrol/ai-configs/), and the README table — so a renamed/removed/unconsumed tag fails the build instead of silently stalling the chain. Agents may emit additional INFORMATIONAL tags not listed here (e.g. tests_generated); only tags the system routes/decides on belong in this registry.

skip_flagging.description: true when the PR needs no flag (Rule F11: infra/docs/chore). Short-circuits the chain at research; approval treats it as a successful no-op, not a rejection.

flag_worthy.description: The research planner's flag-worthiness recommendation. Advisory: no edge or approval logic consumes it (skip_flagging is the actual routing signal). Forced by NODE_REQUIRED_TAGS so the planner always records a recommendation.

flag_action.description: The planner's flag decision: create | extend_variation | ride_existing | child_flag | none. The implementer executes it with the matching tool (create_flag / add_variation / use_existing_flag / create_flag-with-prerequisite); the metrics author picks its mode from it. Forced by NODE_REQUIRED_TAGS. No edge routes on it directly — flag_ready is the verified gate.

flag_ready.description: true when a VERIFIED flag outcome exists: create_flag succeeded (incl. 409 reuse), add_variation appended an iteration variation, or use_existing_flag confirmed an unreleased variation covers the PR. Set only by those tools — never by the agent. Gates the hand-off to the metrics author (replaced flag_created there: an honest 'nothing to create' must not stall the chain).

flag_created.description: true when create_flag succeeded (a flag exists — fresh or 409 reuse). Informational since flag_ready took over edge routing; kept for telemetry and back-compat.

flag_key.description: The flag's key. Set automatically by create_flag / add_variation / use_existing_flag. Used for the release manifest and the editor's LaunchDarkly links.

flag_variation.description: The variation this PR's code path lives under (v1 on a fresh create, vN from add_variation / use_existing_flag). Downstream agents scope metrics/tests to it; the manifest's targetVariation should match it on iteration PRs.

needs_tests.description: true to route to the testing agent. Forced by NODE_REQUIRED_TAGS so the metrics author always hands off.

metrics_created.description: true if any guarded-release metric was created or reused. Set automatically by the create_metric tool.

metric_keys.description: Comma-separated metric keys attached. Set automatically by create_metric. Written into the release manifest and the editor's links.

review_approved.description: The reviewer's verdict (approve/approved/true vs reject/rejected/false). Read by the approval gate. Forced by NODE_REQUIRED_TAGS so the reviewer always records a verdict; absence means the reviewer never ran (INCOMPLETE), not a rejection.

risk_level.description: low / medium / high — the categorical companion to risk_score, for humans and as the fallback mapping (low=.25 / medium=.5 / high=.75) when the numeric score is missing.

risk_score.description: Numeric change risk 0.0-1.0 from the research planner. Read by the approval policy: in risk-threshold mode, steps gate when risk_score >= the auto-factory-risk-threshold flag (fail-closed when absent). Forced by NODE_REQUIRED_TAGS.

metric_event_keys.description: Comma-separated event keys of the event-backed metrics created/reused. Set automatically by create_metric. The deterministic handoff shim greps the checkout for an emitter of each one — a metric whose event nothing emits fails the run mechanically.

tests_last_run.description: pass | fail — the outcome of the LAST real run_tests execution in a node's run. Set automatically by run_tests. The deterministic handoff shim fails the run if a node hands off with a red suite.

sentry_guardrail.description: true when a Sentry-backed shared LD metric (sentry-errors*) was attached as the error killswitch. The handoff verifier checks that launchdarklyContext appears in the checkout (ADR 0014).
